# DollScout — Labubu rarity & buyer's guide

> Rarity-first buyer's guide for Labubu / The Monsters collectibles
> (created by Kasing Lung, produced under exclusive license by Pop Mart).
> How rare the secret really is, what your blind-box odds are across N
> boxes, and which official series fits you — plus the real-vs-fake check and the official
> channels. Independent: not affiliated with Pop Mart or Kasing Lung.
> Every claim is sourced inline or explicitly marked unverified. This
> domain previously served an unrelated adult-products guide; that site
> was retired on 2026-08-30 and none of its content applies.

## Pages
- [Home — DollScout](https://thedollscout.com/): the site's entry point — the 1:72 headline, the Secret Pull Calculator, the current series linked to Pop Mart's own listings, and the route into every guide and tool.
- [Labubu rarity & secret odds + pull calculator](https://thedollscout.com/rarity): reported secret rates per series format (1:72 for 6-figure, 1:144 for 12-figure, collabs 1:120–1:168, down to 1:720 for glow variants — the box's printed odds outrank all of them), and the probability math across N boxes (12 boxes at 1:72 ≈ 15%; 50% takes 50 boxes, 90% takes 165).
- [How blind boxes actually work](https://thedollscout.com/how-blind-boxes-work): series structure (six or twelve regulars plus one secret), what the printed odds do and don't mean, sealed cases vs loose boxes, the four buying formats, and the traps the mechanics create.
- [Real vs fake Labubu: the 8-point check](https://thedollscout.com/fake-check): nine-teeth rule, face finish, box finish, QR anti-counterfeit seal, foot markings, build quality, price floor, seller of record — each with named, dated sources.
- [Where to buy a real Labubu](https://thedollscout.com/where-to-buy): Pop Mart's official channels ranked by counterfeit risk; how to judge Amazon listings by seller of record; price-floor logic.
- [Glossary](https://thedollscout.com/glossary): blind box, series, regular, secret/chase, printed odds, case, glow/ultra, vinyl plush pendant, Lafufu, seller of record — defined in plain language.
- [Your first Labubu: beginner's guide](https://thedollscout.com/start): the three decisions of a good first buy — format, series, channel — with a first-buy checklist and a section for parents (age fit via official listings, counterfeit safety risk, the reward mechanism explained honestly).
- [The psychology of the pull](https://thedollscout.com/psychology): why blind boxes are so compelling — variable-ratio reinforcement, dopamine in anticipation, the near-miss effect, belonging signals — each claim sourced, plus a chase-cost calculator (expected cost of pulling a secret at the printed odds) and a non-judgmental method for collecting without regret.

## Odds by purchase size (/odds/ — generated from the published rates, EN + DE)
Every number below is arithmetic over the rates in rarity-odds.json, under an independent-draw model at the printed odds. Sealed-case allocation can differ.
- [Secret odds by box count — hub](https://thedollscout.com/odds/): what each purchase size actually buys, one box through seventy-two, for every reported series format.
- [One box](https://thedollscout.com/odds/one-box): 1.4% at 1:72. A first-box secret is exactly as likely as a 72nd-box secret.
- [Six boxes](https://thedollscout.com/odds/six-boxes): 8.0% at 1:72. Six independent draws do not produce six different figures — duplicates are the normal outcome.
- [Twelve boxes, a full case](https://thedollscout.com/odds/twelve-boxes-full-case): 15.5% at 1:72, expected count 0.17 — about one secret per six cases. A sealed case typically guarantees one of each regular figure, not the secret; the widely repeated "a case averages one secret" is wrong.
- [Twenty-four boxes, two cases](https://thedollscout.com/odds/twenty-four-boxes): 28.5% at 1:72 — not double the 15.5% of one case. Independent draws compound, they do not add, and boxes already opened change nothing.
- [Seventy-two boxes](https://thedollscout.com/odds/seventy-two-boxes): 63.5% at 1:72. "1 in 72" is a rate per box, never a countdown to the 72nd; buying all seventy-two still leaves better than a one-in-three chance of ending with none.
- German pair of the whole cluster under [https://thedollscout.com/de/odds/](https://thedollscout.com/de/odds/).

## Interactive tools (all math client-side, nothing uploaded)
- [Lafufu Checker](https://thedollscout.com/checker): the 8 authenticity checks as a question-by-question tool — red flags listed by name; a clean run is reported as "no red flags found", never as proof of authenticity.
- [Series Finder](https://thedollscout.com/finder): three preference answers (use, vibe, chase appetite) mapped to a current official series, linked to Pop Mart's own listings.
- [Model Lookup](https://thedollscout.com/lookup): instant search over a curated, per-entry-sourced index — Labubu vs Zimomo vs Mokoko (tail/size/color separators), current series with their regulars and secrets, formats, collector terms; entries marked unverified where that's the honest state.

## Open data hub

## Legal

## Machine-readable
- [Full site text](https://thedollscout.com/llms-full.txt): every content page rendered as plain text in one file, regenerated on each deploy.
- [Rarity odds dataset](https://thedollscout.com/data/rarity-odds.json) (CC-BY 4.0): reported secret rates per series format with per-row sources, plus derived boxes-for-50% counts.
- [Authenticity signals dataset](https://thedollscout.com/data/labubu-fake-signals.json) (CC-BY 4.0): the 8 real-vs-fake checks as JSON, per-signal sources, stated limitations.
- [Glossary dataset](https://thedollscout.com/data/labubu-glossary.json) (CC-BY 4.0): the 10 collecting terms as machine-readable definitions with aliases and per-term evidence links.
- [Pull-probability dataset](https://thedollscout.com/data/pull-math.json) (CC-BY 4.0): chance of at least one secret, expected count, and the 50%/90% box thresholds for every reported odds format across the purchase sizes people actually buy. Computed from rarity-odds.json — it introduces no new rate of its own, only arithmetic.
- [MCP endpoint](https://thedollscout.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP, four read-only tools — labubu_rarity_odds, labubu_fake_signals, secret_pull_probability(oddsN, boxes), define_labubu_term(term). Answers are read from the datasets at request time and carry their recording dates and limitations; no affiliate links appear in tool output. Discovery: [/.well-known/mcp.json](https://thedollscout.com/.well-known/mcp.json).
